decisions.statement: A 404 the not-found classifier matches moves the request to another account.
A rebind has the credential read for the account moved to.
A matched 404 disables the account under a `model_unavailable` reason.
A matched 404 files the account under the reason the classifier read.
One reason met at a second account clears the account filed against that reason.
A reason met at a second account is answered rather than rebound.
A reason met at a second account disables no further account.
A reason met again at the same account disables that account again.
A 404 the classifier does not match is answered rather than rebound.
An unmatched 404 is written about as `none-unmatched`.
An unmatched 404 disables no account.
An answer has the body text upstream sent.
An account already tried coming back is written about as `looped`.
An account with no fresh token is answered rather than rebound.
An account with no fresh token is named in the line written about that account.
The accounts already tried are kept from the choice.
Every 404 answered here is answered 404.
Every terminal 404 goes to the error seam rather than the output seam.
A caller has the map of reasons to accounts across one request's whole walk.
A caller hands in the choice of the next account.
A caller hands in the act disabling an account.
A caller hands in the act clearing an account.
Nothing here sends a request.
Nothing here waits.
Nothing here reads a clock.
`tools/lib/model-gateway/model-unavailable-rebind.ts` takes a `logRes` that file never calls.
The `logRes` seam that old file took is carried nowhere here.
`tools/lib/model-gateway/model-unavailable-rebind.ts` reads 404 rather than the response's status.
Every line written here goes to the console rather than to a seam.
A reason is matched as whole text rather than by any shape within the reason.

definition: the account a request moves to after one account answers that the model is not there
